info.name: Google Cloud Storage JSON BucketAccessControls DefaultObjectAccessControls API
Google Cloud Storage List Default Object Acl Entries

params.name: bucket
params.description: Name of the bucket. Bucket names must be globally unique and comply with naming requirements.

params.name: ifMetagenerationMatch
params.description: If present, only returns the default ACL listing if the bucket's current metageneration matches this value.

params.name: ifMetagenerationNotMatch
params.description: If present, only returns the default ACL listing if the bucket's current metageneration does not match this value.

params.name: userProject
params.description: The project to be billed for this request. Required for Requester Pays buckets.

items.docs: Retrieves default object ACL entries on the specified bucket. These are applied to new objects when no ACL is provided.

params.name: bucket
params.description: Name of the bucket. Bucket names must be globally unique and comply with naming requirements.

params.name: userProject
params.description: The project to be billed for this request. Required for Requester Pays buckets.

items.docs: Creates a new default object ACL entry on the specified bucket.

info.name: Google Cloud Storage Get a Default Object Acl Entry

params.name: bucket
params.description: Name of the bucket. Bucket names must be globally unique and comply with naming requirements.

params.name: entity
params.description: The entity holding the permission, in one of the following forms: user-userId, user-email, group-groupId, group-email, domain-domain, project-team-projectId, allUsers, or allAuthenticatedUsers.

params.name: userProject
params.description: The project to be billed for this request. Required for Requester Pays buckets.

items.docs: Returns the default object ACL entry for the specified entity on the specified bucket.
